name: Manus
verdict: An agent for research, slides, and browser tasks; $20 buys 4,000 credits, and Manus does not publish what one task costs.
pros: One agent for research, slides, sites, and browser tasks
Annual monthly prices are on the pricing toggle
Team credits sit in a shared pool
cons: No published credit price for a single task
The 8,000 and 40,000 cards are selectors, and only the open step is listed
pricingNote: Checked 2026-10-15. manus.im/pricing, monthly view, showed $20/month for 4,000 credits, $40/month for 8,000 credits, and $200/month for 40,000 credits. Each card also lists 300 refresh credits every day, 20 concurrent tasks, and 20 scheduled tasks. The annual toggle is labeled Save 17% and showed $17, $34, and $167 per month, billed yearly, for those same credit amounts. The 8,000 and 40,000 cards have a credit selector; other steps were not open, so they are omitted. Team, on manus.im/team, is $20 per seat a month or $200 per seat a year, with 4,000 credits per seat a month in a shared pool. A help-center article lists a Free plan at $0 with 300 daily credits; that card was not on the pricing page we rendered, so it is not in this table. manus.im/help/credits says a task's cost depends on complexity and duration, across tokens, virtual machines, and third-party APIs, and does not publish a per-task rate.
